context.transcript:
Hi Melissa.
I just spoke with Alberto on the phone.
He doesn't feel well so he won't be able to work the Hassoon Motor Company event tonight.
I need you to cover for him.
Oh, but I've never photographed a corporate event.
I'm usually here in the studio for individual or family portraits.
It would be a new challenge for me but I could use the experience.
Well, you have a keen eye.
I know you'll do great.
The event starts at 7 in the banquet hall of the Norris Hotel.
Remember, there's a formal dress code.
You should probably wear a suit.
Of course.
I'll go home to get ready now.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Melissa。
我刚和Alberto通了电话。
他感觉不舒服，所以今晚不能参加Hassoon Motor Company的活动。
我需要你帮他顶一下。
哦，但我从未拍摄过企业活动。
我通常是在工作室为个人或家庭肖像拍照。
这对我会是一个新的挑战，但我可以用这次经验。
嗯，你的眼光很敏锐。
我知道你会做得很好的。
活动在诺里斯酒店的宴会厅晚上7点开始。
记住，有正式着装要求。
你可能应该穿一套西装。
当然了。
我现在回家准备一下。
